question: A person who spends 80% of his monthly income is able to save ₹6,738 per month. His monthly expenses (in ₹) are:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Savings %** = 100% − 80% = 20%

Given 20% → ₹6,738

**Expenses** (80%) = 4 × **Savings** (20%)

**Expenses** = 4 × 6,738 = ₹26,952

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,952.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8556aa4f3de39b923c647d3eec707d4746c06edb9f532ea6c0e26ed9700dd41.png] 

**Income** = **Expenses** + **Savings**

⇒ Let **Total Monthly Income** be ₹I.

⇒ **Savings %** = 100% − 80% = 20%

⇒ 20% of I = 6,738

⇒ (20/100) × I = 6,738

⇒ I = 6,738 × 5 = ₹33,690

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 80% of 33,690

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 0.8 × 33,690 = ₹26,952

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,952.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Formula

Total Income is always the sum of total Expenditure and total Savings. Income = Expenditure + Savings.

Percentage Base Change

If savings are S and savings percentage is s%, then Total Income = (S ÷ s) × 100.

Ratio Method

If expense is 80%, the ratio of Expense : Savings : Income is 4 : 1 : 5. Knowing any one value allows calculating others via unitary method.
